name: DDROID pump logic - OFF at start; LOW starts filling; FULL or STOP stops
info:
Simulated water-point fill controller.

Inputs (inject nodes):
- Water LOW  (topic level / LOW)
- Water FULL (topic level / FULL)
- STOP       (topic command / STOP)
- Initialise (topic init, runs once at startup)

The Pump controller function holds the pump state in flow context and
follows the rules above. Watch the 'Pump state' debug and the node status.

name: Pump controller
initialize:
// Ensure the pump starts OFF whenever the flow is (re)deployed
flow.set("pump", "OFF");
